lines.en: Donar's mercy...  we have prevailed. I cannot begin to convey our gratitude, Lord Jaromir of Embor.
lines.zh: 多纳尔开恩…… 我们胜利了。我们对您的感激之情无以言表，恩博尔公爵贾洛米。

lines.en: ...Ragavi, I must insist you and your retinue join us in Embor Palace. Surely you could use the rest?
lines.zh: ……拉加维，我坚持要让你和你的手下到恩博尔官邸一聚。你们肯定需要好好休整吧？

lines.en: Lord Jaromir, your kindness is far more than I deserve. You could have lost your life to spare mine. I cannot ask for any more of you.  My commanders are expecting us in a timely manner...
lines.zh: 贾洛米公爵，恕本人无法进一步领受您的好意。您差点为了拯救我牺牲自己的性命。我不能再给您添麻烦。 我的指挥官们还在等着我们暗按时返回……

lines.en: ...  Very well.  Please, walk with Donar for your journey home, General Ragavi.
lines.zh: …… 好吧。 回去的路上也请将多纳尔谨记心头，拉加维将军。
